meta.title: Classification of the open discrepancy cases in the Siaya fiscal ledger
meta.rule: One entry per case in data/siaya-fiscal-ledger.json discrepancies. The class is Takwimu's reading of what the documents print, with the reason and the pages it rests on; it is not an editorial decision. Both values stay as printed, the case stays in the ledger, and no value changes review state. A case is "resolved by source" only when a printed source settles it; each such case is logged in data/conflicts.json and tested in scripts/test-reconciliation.js.

classes.definitional: The two values count different things (for example FIF in or out, revenue estimates against the expenditure budget, County Executive against the whole county government, bills of the year left out), as the documents themselves state.
classes.period or version: A different date, budget version or vintage: for example a later report restating the year, or the original against the supplementary budget.
classes.probable source error: One document gives two figures for the same thing and date and does not reconcile them, or the auditor reports that the county's records disagree.
classes.resolved by source: A printed source settles which figure is internally consistent.
classes.unexplained: Nothing printed explains the difference yet.
